name: Early peoples of southern India
summary: Farming and herding peoples of southern India before its first kingdoms, builders of ash mounds and megalithic tombs. The source maps call them “Dravidians” after the language family most of them likely spoke.

knownFor.label: Ash mounds
knownFor.note: Mounds of burnt cattle dung from Neolithic herding camps.

knownFor.label: Megalithic burials
knownFor.note: Stone circles and dolmens over graves.

knownFor.label: Iron at Adichanallur
knownFor.note: Early iron objects found in burial urns.
